CMFT.description: Equivalent Moment Correction Factor Cm (CMFT). Keyed per element (integer id); OPT_AUTO decides whether Cm is auto-calculated or taken from the CMY/CMZ values provided.

OPT_AUTO.description: Auto-calculate the equivalent moment correction factor. When true the program computes Cm automatically and CMY/CMZ are ignored (OnGet does not return them); when false the user-supplied CMY/CMZ are used.

CMY.description: Equivalent moment correction factor about the y-axis (Cmy). Hard-validated at OnSet: must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0. Used when OPT_AUTO is false.

CMZ.description: Equivalent moment correction factor about the z-axis (Cmz). Hard-validated at OnSet: must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0. Used when OPT_AUTO is false.
